mechanism: Estradiol may increase empagliflozin exposure through inhibition of UGTA1A8/9 enzymes responsible for empagliflozin glucuronidation, and both agents may increase genital infection risk through distinct mechanisms.
action: Monitor for increased empagliflozin side effects (genital mycotic infections, euglycemic DKA risk) and counsel on infection prevention; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical vigilance warranted.
